entries.5616a67fc31d1f2a: A reportable segment that performs and supports part of the work related to clinical trials conducted in the development stage of pharmaceuticals; it is the group's only reportable segment. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,665 million, all of which came from this segment. By region, Japan accounted for ¥3,492 million, the United States ¥2,179 million, Switzerland ¥1,495 million and others ¥1,497 million; major customers are PFIZER, INC. and Philip Morris International Inc.
entries.5940ce0e04a7bf02: Under contracts from pharmaceutical companies and others, it undertakes mainly monitoring, the principal task in clinical trials, along with related quality control, data management, statistical analysis, medical writing, auditing and pharmacovigilance (collection, evaluation, analysis and reporting of safety information such as adverse drug reactions).
entries.5c97e13e47abce3b: The company states that it has the knowledge, technology and experience to carry out and support drug development on an equal footing with major pharmaceutical companies, and that it can also handle disease areas with high development difficulty, such as cancer and the central nervous system, as well as new drug modalities. It provides detailed services for clinical research led by physicians and academia, and for emerging biotech companies that are about to enter Japan or overseas markets, differentiating itself from major global CROs that have large clients and limited resources.
entries.605040886dc16a8b: The company has 100%-owned consolidated subsidiaries in the United States, 10 countries in Europe, South Korea, China, Taiwan, Singapore and Australia, and has a system in place to provide a range of clinical trial services globally on a one-stop basis, from the clinical trial planning stage through all phases.
entries.6630eb80b60f6aa4: A CRO (contract research organization) that undertakes clinical trial (chiken) work from pharmaceutical companies and others, supporting drug development consistently from drug discovery support through post-marketing support.
entries.67566eb8fb5e5387: Centered on monitoring of clinical trials, the company provides quality control, data management, statistical analysis, medical writing, audit and pharmacovigilance services, and provides consistently from consulting at the drug discovery stage through to post-marketing clinical research support.
entries.77bbd25b4e459ecb: A service that supports clinical trials and clinical research after a pharmaceutical product is launched (manufactured and marketed). Drawing on know-how gained in the CRO Business, it undertakes work on organizing structures for corporate- and physician-led clinical research, post-launch planning, monitoring and auditing.
entries.7cecaf4f69a7941d: Support for post-marketing clinical trials and clinical research (Drug Nurturing Business)
entries.82a3f0666d5ac79e: Major customers are pharmaceutical companies and biotech ventures in Japan and abroad. The customers that accounted for 10% or more of net sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were PFIZER, INC. (¥1,259 million) and Philip Morris International Inc. (¥1,180 million).
entries.8be32e2d819b5101: As its management philosophy, the company states that it consistently provides professional-quality service at every stage of drug development and pursues the well-being of its stakeholders: pharmaceutical companies, medical institutions, patients, shareholders and employees. To achieve this, the company focuses on specific disease areas with high unmet medical needs and high development difficulty, such as cancer, the central nervous system and immune diseases. Under its medium-term management plan, with the fiscal year ended March 2028 as the final year, it aims to build a system for conducting international joint clinical trials across Asia including Japan, the United States and Europe, and to differentiate itself from domestic peers by expanding its overseas bases, with the goal of becoming a global CRO originating in Japan.
